newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: Guard and prisoner killed in Zimbabwean jailbreak.
newsitem.headline: Guard and prisoner killed in Zimbabwean jailbreak.

text.p: A prison guard was shot and killed when four prisoners broke out out of a Zimbabwean maximum security prison on Monday, state radio reported.
It said the prisoners made their break while out of their cells for their daily exercise.
One prisoner was killed in a ground and air chase by the army and police.
Two others were recaptured but the fourth was still at large, the radio said.
